title: Freelance E-Commerce Operations & AI Manager - Right Hand to the CBO - 25 - 30h/week
description:
For my client, a DTC jewelry brand I'm looking for the CBO's right hand. You will take a large share of operational and admin work off her plate, keep projects moving and use AI to make the way they work faster.
What you will do
👉Operations: check stock against launches and campaigns, track our manufacturing partner (delays, open orders, quality) and keep new designs on schedule from brief to first order
👉Website & CRO: keep product pages, FAQs and prices up to date, QA before go-live, brief our developers and suggest UX and conversion improvements
👉 Marketing: coordinate with performance marketing and our newsletter agency, support influencer marketing and whitelisting, and bring ideas to our social team (creating content yourself is a plus)
👉Business: understand our product catalogue deeply – what sells and why – and help take customer service to the next level by weighing cost against value
👉Admin: run the CBO's week – agendas, notes, action items and a weekly status update
👉AI: spot recurring tasks and automate them with the best AI tools available
👉You handle follow-ups, QA, reporting and automations independently; decisions on launches, pricing and budgets stay with the CBO, and you prepare them.
The first three months focus on taking work off her plate and learning our processes; after that, automation and wider ownership follow.
Success means the CBO spends noticeably less time on operations and admin.
Must-haves
👉Around 5 years in e-commerce or DTC, ideally fashion, jewelry or beauty
👉Experience in UX and conversion rate optimisation (e.g. A/B tests, product pages, checkout)
👉Daily, hands-on use of AI tools of all kinds, and you keep up with what is new
👉Very structured, proactive and persistent in closing loops
👉Fluent English; German is a strong plus
👉Experienced freelancer, comfortable working remotely in Slack
Nice-to-haves
👉Influencer marketing or whitelisting experience
👉Shopify, Klaviyo, Gorgias, ClickUp or Modash

title: MM Account Executive
description:
Who we are:

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.

About the Role:

As a Mid-Market Account Executive at Motive, you will be pivotal to the growth of our Mid-Market sales segment in the UK, driving new business with companies operating 50- 174 trucks. You will own the full sales cycle from prospecting to closing, working as a relentless "hunter" to identify opportunities, clearly articulate and educate our value proposition, and close key stakeholders. We are looking for driven and experienced sales individuals with a persuasive, natural sales ability and a strong commitment to results.

This is an amazing opportunity to join our fastest growing sales segment with the ability to advance into the Upper Mid-Market and Enterprise segments as well as sales leadership. This is a hybrid role based in our London office, with in-office attendance required 3x per week and travel to customer sites up to 3x per month to win large deals.
